name: Council on Strategic Risks
summary: A Washington DC security-policy institute founded in 2017: its Janne E. Nolan Center on Strategic Weapons works to end biological weapons threats (with the Global Biosecurity Accelerator and biosecurity fellowships), reduce nuclear risks and strengthen arms control; its Center for Climate and Security works with militaries and security agencies on climate risks, the International Military Council on Climate and Security among them; and its Converging Risks Lab studies risks that cut across fields.
